title: Lantern Arcade
edits: float travel = wallDepth * LIB_A + motion * LIB_B;

siblings.title: T Junction Relay
siblings.description: Bright signs stagger the light relays at the junction.

siblings.title: Courtyard Flood
siblings.description: Sprite colours wash across the courtyard masonry.

siblings.title: Elevated Walk Flicker
siblings.description: Repeated artwork becomes a row of engraved walkway plates.

siblings.title: Underpass Slit
siblings.description: The artwork is drawn into separate bars of light running under the passage.

siblings.title: Corner Spill
siblings.description: Separated colour beams spill around the corner.

siblings.title: Paired Alley Chase
siblings.description: Sprite channels steer the two passages in different directions.

siblings.title: Roofwell Descent
siblings.description: Light and dark give the roofwell different relief and shadow.

siblings.title: Box Inversion
siblings.description: The silhouette becomes a cutout through the inverted box panels.

siblings.title: Map Gatefold
siblings.description: Staggered impressions repeat across the folded map.

siblings.title: Corner Peel
siblings.description: Bright marks lift the peeling paper and change its lighting.

siblings.title: Accordion Advance
siblings.description: The sprite holds selected accordion creases back after each hit.

siblings.title: Pocket Turn
siblings.description: Colour bleeds into the turning pockets.

siblings.title: Pleat Collapse
siblings.description: Artwork fractures into chips that ride away on collapsing pleats.

siblings.title: Saddle Twist
siblings.description: The artwork is drawn into tight fibres following the twisted paper.

siblings.title: Shelf Slump
siblings.description: Brightness raises ridges and carves hollows in the slumping shelf.

siblings.title: Core Stack
siblings.description: Copies of the image are pressed into successive bands.

siblings.title: Fan Bury
siblings.description: Sprite colour is sorted into bands as the sediment fan buries them.

siblings.title: Canyon Refill
siblings.description: Sprite channels redirect the movement along the canyon walls.

siblings.title: Bar Migration
siblings.description: Artwork breaks into drifting clasts on migrating sandbars.

siblings.title: Levee Breach
siblings.description: The silhouette breaches the levee and exposes a dark cross-section.

siblings.title: Bed Scour
siblings.description: The image draws thin streaks into the scoured beds.

siblings.title: Forked Slipface
siblings.description: Bright parts of the artwork raise the branching slipfaces and move their highlights.

siblings.title: Corridor Scour
siblings.description: The image is pulled into thin wind-driven scour lines.

siblings.title: Lee Wake
siblings.description: Artwork leaves a drifting sand wake that survives a swap.

siblings.title: Double Dune Collision
siblings.layout: vec2(.5 + abs(q.x) * 1.37 + .06 * sin(t), u.y - .17 * sign(q.x) * q.x)
siblings.description: Image fragments move across the opposing dunes on beats.

siblings.title: Edge Drift
siblings.description: Sprite colours migrate along the leeward sand.

siblings.title: Star Dune Feed
siblings.description: Repeated impressions spiral through the star dunes.

siblings.title: Ridge Overtake
siblings.description: Bright sprite patches hold ridges back as the others advance.

siblings.title: Split Channel Bend
siblings.description: Sprite colour washes through the two channels and stains the reed banks.

siblings.title: Island Shelter
siblings.description: Artwork casts a moving shelter shadow over the reeds.

siblings.title: Diagonal Comb
siblings.description: The image stretches into individual diagonal reed fibres.

siblings.title: Floodplain Flatten
siblings.description: Bright parts lift the flooded beds and alter their grazing light.

siblings.title: Crossing Squalls
siblings.description: Two rain fronts catch separated bands of colour from the artwork.

siblings.title: Furrow Ripple
siblings.description: Old sprite traces keep drifting down the furrows.

siblings.title: Perimeter Sweep
siblings.description: Bright media delays the gusts around the perimeter.

siblings.title: Needle Fan Advance
siblings.description: Sprite edges stretch into long crystal needles.

siblings.title: Branch Confluence
siblings.description: The converging branches split the sprite into colour fringes.

siblings.title: Salt Pan Drydown
siblings.description: Image residue dries into a crust and keeps migrating.

siblings.title: Bridging Crust
siblings.description: Sprite brightness raises the bridge ridges and deepens pits.

siblings.title: Facet Collision
siblings.description: Sprite chips are carried away as large facets collide.

siblings.title: Pinhole Bloom
siblings.description: The artwork casts moving shadows across the fine crystal pores.

siblings.title: Frost Retraction
siblings.description: Bright areas hold the frost at individual junctions before it retracts.

siblings.title: Reef Bypass
siblings.description: Sprite shadows sweep the reef and its schools.

siblings.title: Baitball Escape
siblings.description: Artwork breaks into small schools that scatter from the baitball.

siblings.title: Layer Migration
siblings.description: Brightness raises the apparent water layers and moves the fish between them.

siblings.title: Counterstream Crossing
siblings.description: Sprite channels steer opposing streams across one another.

siblings.title: Shelter Handoff
siblings.description: An old sprite leaves a drifting trail between refuges.

siblings.title: Channel Split
siblings.description: Bright parts hold back sections of the schools before they cross into the other channel.

siblings.title: Eddy Reunion
siblings.description: Sprite colours curl into the returning schools.

siblings.title: Basin Chimneys
siblings.description: Bright parts raise the ground and light the chimney faces.

siblings.title: Crack Vent Crawl
siblings.description: The image becomes fine jets that crawl along the vent crack.

siblings.title: Geyser Pair
siblings.description: Brightness delays the eruption on one side of each geyser pair.

siblings.title: Hollow Backdraft
siblings.description: Sprite channels steer the reversed plume motion.

siblings.title: Shelf Plume Merge
siblings.description: The merging plumes carry colours drawn from the artwork.

siblings.title: Offset Vent Chase
siblings.layout: vec2(u.x + .12 * sin(7.0 * u.y + t), u.y + .15 * sign(q.x) * q.x)
siblings.description: Repeated sprite impressions mark the staggered vent faces.

siblings.title: Crosswind Smear
siblings.description: A previous sprite remains as drifting material in the crosswind.

siblings.title: Triple Point Merge
siblings.description: The triple point separates the sprite into colour fronts.

siblings.title: Dryline Intrusion
siblings.description: The alpha silhouette cuts a dry intrusion through the rain field.

siblings.title: Polar Wrap
siblings.description: Sprite channels wind the isobars around the pole.

siblings.title: Occluded Front
siblings.description: A projected silhouette darkens and lengthens the occluded front.

siblings.title: Gust Ring Escape
siblings.description: Bright regions delay the local expansion of gust rings.

siblings.title: Jet Streak Split
siblings.description: Sprite detail is drawn out into long jet streaks.

siblings.title: Convergence Sweep
siblings.description: Old artwork stays in the weather field and drifts toward the convergence line.

siblings.title: Trench Split
siblings.description: The trench splits the sprite into separated wavelength bands.

siblings.title: Step Refocus
siblings.description: Bright detail becomes small changes in basin depth with lit edges.

siblings.title: Pebble Scatter
siblings.description: Artwork breaks into moving chips among the pebble reflections.

siblings.title: Channel Crosslight
siblings.description: The sprite blocks angled rays and throws moving shadows.

siblings.title: Sandbar Bend
siblings.layout: vec2(u.x, u.y + .16 * exp(-6.0 * abs(q.x)) * sin(t + 6.0 * q.x))
siblings.description: The sandbar takes on colours streamed from the sprite.

siblings.title: Pool Convergence
siblings.description: A sprite leaves a pool of light that drifts and fades.

siblings.title: Rim Reflection
siblings.description: Repeated reflections emboss the rim with copies of the artwork.

siblings.title: Stair Shadow Climb
siblings.description: Brightness raises treads and reshapes the shadows climbing them.

siblings.title: Parapet Sundial
siblings.description: Repeated artwork is etched on a series of sundial faces.

siblings.title: Opposed Lamps
siblings.description: Opposed lamps send separate colour images across the brick.

siblings.title: Slat Crossover
siblings.description: Slats pull the sprite into alternating narrow light threads.

siblings.title: Corner Wrap
siblings.layout: vec2(u.x + .19 * sin(4.0 * u.y - t), u.y + .18 * abs(q.x))
siblings.description: Sprite channels push the wall pattern around the corner.

siblings.title: Beam Eclipse
siblings.description: The silhouette cuts a gap through the beam.

siblings.title: Screen Handoff
siblings.description: Sprite residue moves across successive screens after the handoff.

siblings.title: Offset Stamp Relay
siblings.description: Small mirrored artwork stamps are pressed into alternate strips.

siblings.title: Diagonal Brush Reversal
siblings.description: Sprite channels switch the direction of the brushing.

siblings.title: Fluted Panel Sweep
siblings.description: Pigment from the image stains the moving fluted panels.

siblings.title: Raised Seal Flash
siblings.description: Bright image regions flash after adjacent foil has already caught the beat.

siblings.title: Woven Foil Glide
siblings.description: Fine threads from the artwork interleave with the woven foil.

siblings.title: Tension Wrinkle
siblings.layout: vec2(u.x, u.y + .22 * sin(4.0 * u.x) * sin(t + 6.0 * q.x))
siblings.description: The sprite opens a dark tear in the wrinkling surface.

siblings.title: Creased Edge Spark
siblings.description: Different colour channels strike different edges of the crease.

siblings.title: Checkerboard Flip
siblings.description: Copies are carved into alternating shutter blades.

siblings.title: Diagonal Unzip
siblings.description: Threads from the artwork unzip the slats along the diagonal.

siblings.title: Slot Crossover
siblings.description: The slot separates the sprite into crossing beams.

siblings.title: Corner Aperture
siblings.description: Bright artwork rises on the corners and changes the aperture relief.

siblings.title: Opposed Banks
siblings.description: Artwork holds selected shutters shut for part of each beat.

siblings.title: Floor to Ceiling Roll
siblings.description: Sprite colour flows up the rolling shutters.

siblings.title: Interlocking Iris
siblings.description: Sprite fragments travel separately across the interlocking leaves.

siblings.title: Keystone Ringdown
siblings.description: Bright pixels delay individual keystones before their ringdown.

siblings.title: Brick Bond Slip
siblings.description: The sprite repeats in relief along the offset brick courses.

siblings.title: Mosaic Fan Flex
siblings.description: The image becomes coloured glaze across the mosaic fan.

siblings.title: Travelling Ridge
siblings.description: The image steers the slab ripple along the ridge.

siblings.title: Scallop Snap
siblings.description: The silhouette opens a dark fissure through the scalloped tiles.

siblings.title: Split Panel Rebound
siblings.description: Sprite pieces move as separate chips on the split panel.

siblings.title: Corner Load
siblings.description: Sprite-shaped shadows rake over the corner load.

siblings.title: Headline Slam
siblings.description: Bright image areas raise headline type and cast bevel light.

siblings.title: Diagonal Proof
siblings.description: The sprite inks the diagonal proof in its own colours.

siblings.title: Corner Index
siblings.description: Small repeated images are impressed into the index blocks.

siblings.title: Loose Type Cascade
siblings.description: The sprite breaks into loose type that slips out of position.

siblings.title: Margin Chase
siblings.description: Threads from the image run down the moving margins.

siblings.title: Reversed Forme
siblings.description: The sprite cuts letter-shaped voids through the reversed forme.

siblings.title: Overprint Collision
siblings.description: Colour separations overlap out of register on the overprint.

siblings.title: Switchyard Detour
siblings.description: Repeated sprite impressions mark the detours and their switching plates.

siblings.title: Ring Bypass
siblings.description: Old artwork circulates as a decaying packet trail in the bypass.

siblings.title: Crossbar Handoff
siblings.description: Colour channels hand off to separate crossbar routes.

siblings.title: Branch Fanout
siblings.description: The sprite fans into narrow signal threads.

siblings.title: Loopback Queue
siblings.description: Brightness keeps packets queued for different lengths after each beat.

siblings.title: Merge Priority
siblings.description: Sprite colour spreads into the converging traces.

siblings.title: Bridge Failover
siblings.description: The sprite projects a moving blackout across the bridge and its traces.

siblings.title: Radial Drum Record
siblings.description: Copies of the sprite stamp into the cylindrical paper.

siblings.title: Opposed Paper Feeds
siblings.description: Different sprite channels travel in opposite directions on the paper.

siblings.title: Spiral Trace Spool
siblings.description: The sprite steers the pen positions as the record spools.

siblings.title: Crossfeed Pens
siblings.description: Image colours feed into the separate pen marks.

siblings.title: Lane Skips
siblings.description: The silhouette cuts gaps through the selected record lanes.

siblings.title: Foldout Record
siblings.description: The folded chart rises and catches a bevel wherever the image is bright.

siblings.title: Alternating Drum Banks
siblings.description: Bright parts delay each drum bank after the hit.

siblings.title: Interlaced Quarry
siblings.description: The interlaced rows separate the sprite into colour channels.

siblings.title: Opposed Scan Faces
siblings.description: The sprite casts a moving shadow between the opposing scan faces.

siblings.title: Zigzag Bench Cut
siblings.description: Repeated sprite impressions are cut into the zigzag bench.

siblings.title: Diagonal Stripping
siblings.description: The artwork is pulled into individual diagonal strips.

siblings.title: Patch Excavation
siblings.description: Image pieces break away as moving excavation patches.

siblings.title: Corner Traverse
siblings.description: Stored image marks follow the corner and fade through several sweeps.

siblings.title: Depth Relay
siblings.description: Bright zones wait longer before triggering the next depth response.

siblings.title: Twin Baseline
siblings.description: The twin scan separates the sprite into individual spectral returns.

siblings.title: Bottom Sounding
siblings.description: Sprite brightness raises the apparent seabed.

siblings.title: Side Scan Handoff
siblings.description: Previous artwork stays in the wake of the side scan.

siblings.title: Fan Beam Search
siblings.description: The artwork is drawn into narrow rays from the beam fan.

siblings.title: Staggered Transects
siblings.description: Repeated sprite marks appear on successive transects.

siblings.title: Cross Echo
siblings.description: The silhouette cuts holes where the echoes cross.

siblings.title: Range Fold
siblings.description: The sprite channels shift the direction and phase of the range folds.

siblings.title: Ceiling Cascade
siblings.description: Bright areas keep some weights back before they swing.

siblings.title: Sidewall Escapement
siblings.description: The sprite casts swinging shadows across the sideways pendulum bank.

siblings.title: Counterphase Banks
siblings.description: Opposing banks catch separated colours from the sprite.

siblings.title: Double Link Transfer
siblings.description: Sprite pieces move like separately released counterweights.

siblings.title: Suspended Bridge
siblings.description: Artwork runs as strands through the hanging cables.

siblings.title: Staggered Row Catch
siblings.description: The last sprite hangs on as a moving trace behind the staggered rows.

siblings.title: Floor Pivot Rebound
siblings.description: Brightness changes the apparent raised height and lighting of the floor-mounted weights.

siblings.title: Return Belt
siblings.description: The returning cargo carries pigment drawn from the sprite.

siblings.title: Sorting Gate
siblings.description: Bright zones hold their gates before releasing the next loads.

siblings.title: Belt Weave
siblings.description: The image is drawn out into strands that interleave with the belt weave.

siblings.title: Ramp Exchange
siblings.description: Brightness raises cargo and exposes the edges of the ramp.

siblings.title: Gravity Chute
siblings.description: The sprite splits into chunks that drop independently.

siblings.title: Turntable Merge
siblings.description: Repeated impressions mark the turntable and its transfer plates.

siblings.title: Recirculation Loop
siblings.description: Older artwork keeps circulating as a fading cargo trace.

siblings.title: Tidal Slingshot
siblings.description: Sprite detail draws long particle wakes through the slingshot.

siblings.title: Edge Well Transit
siblings.description: The sprite eclipses the travelling wells and their orbit lines.

siblings.title: Trojans Scatter
siblings.description: Pieces of the sprite scatter as separate orbital debris.

siblings.title: Flyby Exchange
siblings.description: The flyby separates colour channels into offset passes.

siblings.title: Ring Shepherd
siblings.description: The sprite repeats at staggered positions among the rings.

siblings.title: Three Body Ejection
siblings.description: Bright areas hold part of the ejection back until later in the beat.

siblings.title: Counterorbit Capture
siblings.description: Older images trail away while new material joins the opposite orbit.

siblings.title: Offset Sieve
siblings.description: Repeated sprite perforations mark the sieve beds.

siblings.title: Split Hopper
siblings.description: The split hopper casts sprite-shaped shadows across the falling grains.

siblings.title: Incline Slide
siblings.description: Sprite channels turn the path of grains along the incline.

siblings.title: Pocket Fill
siblings.description: Artwork keeps building a deposit as the pockets fill.

siblings.title: Talus Spill
siblings.description: The image breaks into chips that travel with the spilling talus.

siblings.title: Layer Inversion
siblings.description: Sprite pigments are mixed into the inverted layers.

siblings.title: Bridge Collapse
siblings.description: Bright image zones delay sections of the bridge before collapse.

siblings.title: Channel Vent
siblings.description: The image draws taut threads between the venting pockets.

siblings.title: Checkerboard Breathing
siblings.description: The sprite repeats as pressed marks on alternating cells.

siblings.title: Corner Squeeze
siblings.description: Brightness raises fabric near the corner and changes its lighting.

siblings.title: Spiral Bladder Fill
siblings.description: Sprite channels twist the moving fabric around the filling spiral.

siblings.title: Baffle Handoff
siblings.description: Bright areas hold back a pocket before its pressure wave passes on.

siblings.title: Foldback Deflation
siblings.description: The silhouette cuts through the folded fabric as it deflates.

siblings.title: Crossfeed Surge
siblings.description: Fading sprite traces travel from pocket to pocket.
